author: SGMC
body:
Reported Player(s): BackFromTheDeath
Rules Broken: Hacking / modded client
Evidence: Well, Here's a video of him falling and not taking damage. Yes, I realize that he could be using the Stomper kit, but he openly admitted that he was hacking multiple times and I asked if he was serious, which provided no response. I said I would report him and he said that he "just doesn't care anymore".

replies.author: _Stormz
replies.body:
Hey there!

This does not seem to have enough evidence that this person was hacking. As you have mentioned, he could have been using the Stomper kit. Furthermore, him "admitting" that he was a hacker does not immediately mean that he was actually hacking. 

Do you have anymore evidence?

replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
Just thought I would mention that NoFall is patched on here. Even if he tried to use the hack, he would take fall damage anyway. 

He could also be joking around. Although his second statement is a little.. unnecessary, this is not enough to 100% confirm that he is hacking.

Thanks for the report, but this player will not be dealt with. :)
